about_the_game:
Aliens have landed and they’re starving for pizza!

In 10,000 Pizzas Please, you’ll build a fully automated pizza factory to serve wave after wave of hungry extraterrestrial customers. Gather ingredients, lay down rails, power your machines and craft the most efficient production line in the galaxy.

Plan. Build. Deliver.

Use limited energy and resources to create the ultimate pizza pipeline... Every ingredient has a cost, and every machine consumes energy, efficiency is the key to success.

Two Ways to Play

In the full version, choose between Mission Mode, where you tackle handcrafted challenges, and Free Factory Mode, where you can build without limits and experiment freely.

This demo focuses on Mission Mode only, featuring 3 unique levels to test your factory-building skills.

Automation Meets Cooking

From raw dough to sizzling perfection, udeploy a range of machines: Dough Pressers, Sauce Dispensers, Chees and more!

Demo Features – Automation Fest Edition

  • 4 Tasty Ingredients
    Pepperoni, mushroom, olives, and tomato; craft delicious combos with limited yet flavorful options.

  • Core Automation Machines
    Test your setup with essential machines: dough pressers, sauce dispensers, topping units, and ovens.

  • Energy & Cost Management
    Every machine consumes energy and resources. Efficiency is your path to success.

  • Mission Mode Preview
    Play through 3 handcrafted challenge levels designed to push your factory-building skills.

  • Replayability
    Tweak, optimize, and perfect your pipeline for higher scores and smoother operation.

  • Polished Visuals
    Enjoy a clean, colorful visual style that makes managing chaos a treat.

Full version will include 11+ ingredients, advanced machines, Free Factory Mode, and galaxy-wide alien orders!Can you satisfy the galaxy’s appetite?Wishlist Now!..

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-4440 CPU
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel(R) UHD Graphics 630, 1GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8700 CPU
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Build and automate your own pizza factory to feedwaves of hungry aliens! Manage resources, optimize machines, and design the ultimate production line in this delightfully chaotic automation & cooking sim packed with cheese, conveyor belts, and cosmic mayhem.
